test_title: PYST 58: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held  on 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
In the following sentence, four words are underlined, out of which one word is MISSPELT. Select the MISSPELT word.

The __shedule followed__ by my sister __ultimately __leads to stress and other __adverse__ effects.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word 'shedule' is misspelt. The correct spelling is 'schedule'.
 
• The other words 'ultimately', 'adverse', and 'followed' are correctly spelt.

Therefore, the correct statement is '***The schedule__ followed by my sister ultimately leads to stress and other adverse effects.'***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• It is important to **double-check the spelling** of words to avoid such errors.
 
• Using tools like **spell checkers** can help identify and correct misspelt words.
